episodes.209356: A coastal low moved across the northern gulf coast producing rain and thunderstorms. Minor flooding occurred in Lafayette. Strong north winds behind the front pushed tides below normal.
episodes.209725: Strong southwesterly winds gusted above storm force at times on the 4th.
